title: Text typed into the value page's Add form while its save runs is wiped, silently, when the save lands ok
evidence: Seen in the design note for the value page's Add untangle (D5, the owner's pick (a): leave as today, logged here). While a save is out only Add is disabled (widget-src/src/components/ValuePage.tsx, AddValue: disabled={form.kind === 'saving'}); the Date and Value fields stay editable. On ok, add() clears the text, the diastolic and the day (setText(''); setDia(''); setDate(today)), so anything typed after the press is lost with no word. Not seen by a person; read from the code. Remedies, each a visible change: (b) make the fields read-only while saving (keeps focus and the phone keyboard); (c) keep text typed after the save was sent when it lands. Fixed 2026-11-25 by remedy (b), the owner ruling of that day: the Date and Value fields (both blood pressure numbers too) are readOnly while form.kind is saving (ValuePage.tsx AddValue), so focus and the keyboard stay and nothing typed meanwhile is wiped. US-03 AC2b; ValuePage.add-readonly.test.tsx failed 4 of 4 on main (expected false to be true, readOnly).
